entries.summary: ParticleManager 是唯一 VFX 公共接口（class_name ParticleManager），提供两个静态工厂：spawn_explosion(parent, world_position, size=1.0, color=Color(1.0,0.6,0.2)) 和 spawn_smoke(parent, world_position, size=1.0, color=Color(0.5,0.5,0.5))。spawn_smoke 通过复用 explosion 场景并调低 size 实现。特效会优先挂载到 root 下名为 Effects 的 Node2D 容器，否则挂到 parent，最终 fallback 到 root。
explosion.gd 是纯程序化粒子：在 _ready 中创建 24*size 个圆形粒子，每个粒子有位置、速度、颜色、大小、独立寿命；_process 中更新速度与位置并 queue_redraw，达到 life=1.2 后 queue_free。颜色为黄/橙/红/白随机。整体 alpha 随 elapsed/life 线性衰减。爆心附加 0.1 秒闪光。
hit_spark.gd 是程序化命中火花：在实例化后调用 spark(color, intensity=1.0) 才会生成 8*intensity 个粒子并激活。粒子在 _process 中运动减速，0.4-0.6 秒后清除并 queue_free。alpha 线性衰减。
screen_flash.gd 是 CanvasLayer，process_mode=ALWAYS、layer=100，在 _ready 时创建全屏 ColorRect。调用 flash(intensity=0.5) 使用 Tween 在 0.3 秒内将红闪 alpha 从 intensity 渐变到 0。玩家受击时调用。
star_field.gd 是背景星空，3 层视差星（70+45+18 颗），速度不同且带闪烁。_process 中向下滚动并在出屏后回顶部。set_palette(stage) 在阶段切换时（每 5 波/Stage）平滑插值到 HSV 偏移后的配色，过渡时间 1.5 秒。
player_trail.gd 是 class_name PlayerTrail，提供 reset(pos) 和 tick(delta, pos)。每 0.025 秒在玩家位置记录历史点，最多保留 14 个；tick 中按时间衰减并在 0.6 秒后自动释放。绘制时按历史索引 t 计算 alpha 和大小，越新越亮越大。

shield_effect.gd 绘制护盾脉冲：top_level=true，在 _process 中跟随 parent.global_position，pulse 以 4 倍速度循环。_draw 绘制中心圆+外弧，alpha 在 0.3±0.2 间波动。但 res://scenes/shield_effect.tscn 当前没有挂载该脚本，仅为空 Node2D（ShieldEffect），需要重新关联脚本。

Main (main.tscn + main.gd) is the runtime bootstrap: it ensures GameManager and AudioManager singletons exist as children of get_tree().root, registers input actions (alt_shoot/dodge/shop/crafting), and then instantiates Menu as its child.

GameManager (game_manager.gd) is the global score/lives/leaderboard singleton with PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS. Signals: score_changed, high_score_changed, lives_changed. Stores score, high_score (derived from leaderboard top), lives (clamped 0-5), combo, score_multiplier. Leaderboard stored at user://leaderboard.save, max 10 entries, sorted by score. Public API: reset_run(), add_score(amount), tick_combo(delta), record_score(value, wave), get_leaderboard(), get_top_score(), is_top_score(), is_on_leaderboard().

Game scene (game.tscn + game.gd) is the core gameplay loop node (Node2D). It manages player, bullets, enemies, effects, powerups, asteroids, wave logic, spawn/powerup/wave/asteroid timers, screen flash, and a unified UI_Layer CanvasLayer containing HUD and PauseMenu. It exposes helper statics _gm(), _am(), _sm(). Game loop includes paused/game_over flags, hitstop_timer, wave_kills, wave_hits, total_kills, milestone_timer. It persists progress via SaveManager by calling _save_progress().

Scene transition pattern: Menu, Game, GameOver, and Leaderboard UI are all instantiated as children of Main (or root fallback), and the old scene calls queue_free() after adding the new one. No SceneTree.change_scene_to_file is used. _get_scene_holder() walks up parents until it finds Main, else uses get_tree().root.

Pause flow: Game._toggle_pause() toggles get_tree().paused and pause_menu.visible. PauseMenu has process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS and an _unhandled_input handler so ESC also resumes. PauseMenu can save/load progress (SaveManager), restart game, or return to menu.

GameOver UI (game_over.gd) displays final_score, wave_reached, high_score, and a NEW RECORD label when final_score >= high_score. Buttons Retry (instantiates new Game) and Menu (instantiates new Menu) follow the same child-of-Main pattern.

Leaderboard UI (leaderboard.gd) populates Center/Scroll/List with HBox rows from GameManager.get_leaderboard(). Emits back_pressed signal; fallback _get_scene_holder() + Main pattern. Empty state shown via EmptyLabel.
Menu (menu.gd) sets labels/texts, animates title scale, spawns a star_field background, plays menu music, and starts the game by instantiating game.tscn under Main and freeing itself.

HUD (hud.gd) binds to GameManager signals score_changed, high_score_changed, lives_changed and calls GameManager.tick_combo every frame. It also binds to player signals powerup_collected, weapon_level_changed, weapon_type_changed via attach_player(player). Uses Engine.get_main_loop().root.get_node_or_null("GameManager") and ("WeaponSystem") singleton lookups.

CraftingUI (crafting_ui.gd) opens/closes with open()/close(), emits crafting_opened/crafting_closed. Reads recipes via CraftingSystem.get_all_recipes/get_recipe, inventory via CraftingSystem.get_inventory, and calls CraftingSystem.craft(recipe_id). Updates on CraftingSystem signals recipe_crafted, crafting_failed, inventory_changed. Closes on KEY_ESCAPE or KEY_C.

ShopUI (shop_ui.gd) opens/closes with open()/close(), emits shop_opened/shop_closed. Reads items via ShopSystem.get_all_items/get_item, current score via ShopSystem.get_current_score, and calls ShopSystem.purchase(item_id). Updates on ShopSystem signals item_purchased, purchase_failed. Closes on KEY_ESCAPE or KEY_B.

SettingsManager is a singleton (likely autoload) that persists audio (master/sfx/music volume) and difficulty to user://settings.cfg. Exports master_volume, sfx_volume, music_volume, difficulty. Provides set_* helpers that apply to AudioServer buses, emit *_changed signals, and call save_settings(). Difficulty names: EASY/NORMAL/HARD with multipliers 0.75/1.0/1.35.

DamagePopup is a Node2D scene with a Label. Exports value (int), is_heal (bool), lifetime, float_speed. Has static spawn(parent, value, is_heal, world_position) helper. Uses a tween to float upward and fade out over lifetime. Heal uses green, damage uses red.

settings_menu.tscn is currently incomplete/broken: only has a black Background ColorRect and a few Labels that are direct children of the root (NOT inside the Center VBox), with font color black on black background. There are no HSlider, Button, or back controls; Title and Subtitle labels overlap Center container and are invisible. Needs controls wired to SettingsManager.

Player is an Area2D in res://scripts/player.gd with custom _draw polygon ship. Exports speed=420, max_hp=5. Runtime signals: died, shoot, shoot_spread, hit, powerup_collected(type), weapon_level_changed(level), weapon_type_changed(weapon_type).

Player has two independent shield mechanisms: (1) timed shield via `shield` bool + `shield_timer` (6s from powerup/shop, blocks one hit) and (2) ShieldSystem energy shield via `shield` action (drains energy, recharges). Only energy shield uses ShieldSystem + shield_effect visual.

Player weapon system uses WeaponSystem autoload (res://scripts/weapon_system.gd). Three types: PISTOL(0), SPREAD(1), LASER(2), levels 0-3. Player has primary fire (current type/level) and secondary spread fire (always type SPREAD level 1). XP leveling: add_weapon_xp() raises level until 3 then caps XP.
Player dodge roll: spacebar (action 'dodge'), duration 0.4s, cooldown 1.5s, speed 900, invuln during dodge. _ready registers 'dodge' and removes KEY_SPACE from 'shoot' to avoid conflict.

ShopSystem and CraftingSystem are autoload singletons that call static helper _player() to locate the player under Game scene. They apply effects via player.heal(), player.upgrade_weapon(), player._explode_all_enemies(), and setting player.shield/shield_timer/rapid_fire_timer. Both have _can_apply checks for max HP (max_hp<8) and max weapon (weapon_level>=3 and weapon_type>=2).

Game.gd wires player signals: shoot->spawn bullets, shoot_spread->spawn spread bullets, hit->screen flash/shake/explosion, died->respawn or game over. Collisions: player.overlaps_area(enemy/bullet) calls player.take_damage. Powerups call player.apply_powerup.

Player issues: (1) take_damage returns true even when invulnerable (return false only branch) and after death logic returns true instead of false. (2) powerup type 5 calls upgrade_weapon() which also emits weapon_level_changed; but add_weapon_xp also emits powerup_collected(5) on level up. (3) spread secondary fire hardcodes type 1 level 1 from WeaponSystem. (4) ShieldSystem signals are emitted in _process every frame when active/recharging, causing frequent signal traffic. (5) Player holds old `shield` bool and new ShieldSystem simultaneously; shop/crafting use bool, ShieldSystem uses input action.

AudioManager is a runtime singleton created in main.gd under /root/AudioManager. It provides procedural SFX (pool of 16 AudioStreamPlayers on Master bus) and procedural music (single looping AudioStreamWAV on Master bus). SFX types: shoot, hit, explode, powerup, click, damage, gameover, wave, warning. Music tracks: menu, game. It does NOT expose signals or exported vars; volume/mute is controlled by SettingsManager via AudioServer bus levels (Master/SFX/Music).

AudioManager only mixes SFX and music into the Master bus; it ignores SFX and Music buses. SettingsManager.apply_audio_buses sets Master/SFX/Music bus volumes via AudioServer, but AudioManager's players all use bus='Master'. As a result, the SFX and Music volume sliders will only affect other code that uses those buses; AudioManager output is controlled solely by Master volume plus per-call random volume_db/pitch_scale.

Callers of AudioManager use static helper _am() returning /root/AudioManager. SFX callers include: player (shoot/hit/damage), enemy (shoot/explode?), boss (warning, explode), bullet (no), explosion (no), game (wave/gameover?), menu (click), pause_menu (click), shop_ui (click). Need to verify each call site individually.

SettingsManager exposes signals master_volume_changed, sfx_volume_changed, music_volume_changed, but no script in the scanned project connects to them. Mute is implicit when volume=0 via linear_to_db; there is no explicit mute toggle or bus-mute API call.

Enemy/Boss subsystem is driven by game.gd: enemies are spawned in Node2D 'Enemies', bullets in Node2D 'Bullets'. Collisions are handled by game._collisions_check() every frame using overlaps_area, not signal-based area_entered for enemies. Enemy and Boss emit killed(score_value, position) and damaged(hp) signals to Game.

Enemy.gd supports 6 types: SCOUT, FIGHTER, TANK, BOMBER, SWEEPER, CARRIER. Each has distinct hp, speed, score, fire_rate, movement pattern, and color. Carrier spawns SCOUT minions on fire and on death. 10% chance to become elite (2x hp, 3x score, 1.5x speed, faster fire). Projectile container can be set via set_projectile_container().

Boss.gd is a 3-phase Area2D boss with 120 HP. Phase 1 at <=66% HP, Phase 2 at <=33% HP. Each phase changes shoot interval and fire pattern: phase 0 single aimed shot, phase 1 triple fan, phase 2 16-way radial burst. Uses take_damage(dmg=1) and emits killed(score_value, position), damaged(hp). Boss scene's CollisionShape2D has NO shape assigned — collision will not work.

Asteroid.gd is a procedural Area2D enemy with random polygon shape, HP 2-5, velocity, and rotation. On death it spawns 3 fragments (smaller asteroids) with 1 HP each. On collision with bullet or player, it drops crafting material via CraftingSystem.add_material. Uses area_entered signal for collision, unlike Enemy/Boss which rely on game._collisions_check().

Enemy bullets are created from scenes/enemy_bullet.tscn using script bullet.gd (not a dedicated enemy_bullet.gd). The script sets is_enemy=true/velocity downward based on caller. It has visual trail/glow via Line2D and PointLight2D but only if present in scene. Collision detection in game._collisions_check() checks b.is_enemy and player overlap.

Cortex architecture is a tree of LLM nodes (Root → Branch → Worker) with information isolation: each node only sees its own domain, task from parent, and child reports. Tools are split into perception / configuration / composite to reduce context bloat.

Legacy toolset has 8 modules with 61 tools (scene_tools, node_query_tools, script_tools, script_file_tools, project_tools, file_tools, screenshot_tools, exec_tools). Banyan adds 14 more in perception_tools, configuration_tools, composite_tools. _count_tools.gd can be run to verify totals.

Headless test result files: tests/all_tools_results.json (49 passed, 1 failed, 25 skipped), tests/cortex_mvp_results.json (89 passed, 0 failed), tests/phase7d_results.json (50 passed, 0 failed), tests/phase7e_results.json (97 passed, 0 failed), tests/results.json (5 UI compile checks), tests/results_summary.txt (5/5 Banyan tool tests). _ping_result.json shows Godot 4.5-stable headless is available.

Temporary/deprecated files: temp_file_splitter.gd and temp_split_player.gd are documented as deprecated temp files originally for splitting source into LLM chunks; no longer referenced and safe to delete. save_manager_new.gd is a stub with only a comment 'Temporary file - can be deleted'. save_manager.gd is the real autoload SaveManager singleton.

project.godot configures Star Hunter (2D space shooter) with autoloads: SaveManager, GameManager, AudioManager, TaskRunner (legacy), ComboSystem, WeaponSystem, ShopSystem, CraftingSystem. Main scene is res://scenes/main.tscn. Plugin enabled: res://addons/dotagent/plugin.cfg. Input actions include shoot, pause, special, etc.

Tests are split into three categories: (1) EditorScript tests (run_tests.gd, run_task.gd) run via Ctrl+Shift+X and require an editor scene; (2) SceneTree headless tests (test_all_tools.gd, test_runner.gd, run_banyan_headless.gd, _ping.gd, _test_*.gd) run via `godot --headless --script ...`; (3) repro/diagnostic tests (_repro_graph_*.gd, _test_ctx_persist.gd, _test_resolver.gd) target specific Banyan bugs.
项目所有非插件文件已被 7 个子节点分区解析：Player、Enemies、GameMaster、Audio、UI、VFX、ProjectDocs。各子系统公共接口和主要问题已记录。Root 已整合全局问题清单，包括总线配置缺失、leaderboard 场景缺脚本、shield_effect 场景缺脚本、Boss 碰撞体缺失、设置菜单 UI 损坏、临时文件未清理。
AudioManager 将 SFX 和 Music 播放器都设为 bus = "Master"，但 SettingsManager 尝试通过 SFX/Music 总线设置音量。若 project.godot 未配置 default_bus_layout 中的 SFX/Music 总线，音量滑块对 AudioManager 完全无效。需要确认或修复总线布局。

多个场景/脚本存在结构性 bug：res://scenes/leaderboard.tscn 根节点未挂载 res://scripts/leaderboard.gd；res://scenes/shield_effect.tscn 未挂载 res://scripts/shield_effect.gd；res://scenes/boss.tscn 的 CollisionShape2D 没有 shape；res://scenes/settings_menu.tscn 字体与背景同色且无交互控件。这些问题需要在对应子节点修复。
